post.description: Each party accepts separately, and the contract becomes SIGNED only when both have: the second acceptance, in the same transaction, moves the contract (compare-and-set on its version) and publishes CONTRACT_SIGNED; every acceptance is an audit record (CONTRACT_SIGNATURE_RECORDED). The employer’s side is signed by the roles the `contract.signature` approval policy in force for its organization names (/v1/contract-approval-policies; the signature records the policy’s id and version): with none in force nobody signs for the employer, 422 `SIGNATURE_POLICY_REQUIRED`. One person cannot sign for both sides — a caller who is a member of both organizations is refused (403 `MEMBER_OF_BOTH_PARTIES`) and so is one who already signed the other side (403 `SAME_PERSON_BOTH_SIDES`); two signers whose identities cannot be told apart are 422 `ACTOR_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN`. post.description: The step’s authority decides the named step (`chain`, `stepOrder`) of the chains snapshotted at submission (ADR-068 § 5): the technical chain while the statement is SUBMITTED, the financial one once it is TECHNICALLY_APPROVED (422 `CHAIN_NOT_OPEN`), each chain in its step order (422 `STEP_NOT_NEXT`). 403.description: Authenticated, but not permitted: a role neither the configuration (CONTRACT_READER_ROLES) nor the contractor side grants (INSUFFICIENT_ROLE), the oversight role, a service-to-service token, or a SYSTEM_ADMIN that has not selected an organization with X-Organization-Id. On sign and cancel: a role the employer’s `contract.signature` policy (sign), CONTRACT_CANCEL_ROLES (cancel) or the CONTRACTOR side does not grant, the platform administrator (never, whatever else the token holds; recorded as a refusal when it acts for a party’s organization), a user token without the platform user id, the contractor cancelling, and the separation of duties — a member of both parties, one person on both sides. On amendments and milestones: only the employer proposes an amendment (PROPOSER_NOT_EMPLOYER) or plans and changes a milestone (EDITOR_NOT_EMPLOYER), with a role CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_ROLES / CONTRACT_MILESTONE_ROLES names; signing an amendment is judged like signing the contract (including POLICY_AUTHOR_NOT_GOVERNING, MEMBER_OF_BOTH_PARTIES and SAME_PERSON_BOTH_SIDES). On statements: only the winning contractor drafts and submits (AUTHOR_NOT_CONTRACTOR), with the CONTRACTOR role; the platform administrator acting for a party is refused and recorded. On a statement’s decisions: only the organization the named step names, with its role (NOT_STEP_AUTHORITY, INSUFFICIENT_ROLE), never a member of the contractor’s organization (MEMBER_OF_CONTRACTOR) and never the platform administrator. When refused for a closed reason, `details` names it: one entry, `path` the area (signature, cancellation, policy, amendment, milestone, statement, decision) and `code` the reason, one of those listed here. Branch on `code` and `details[].code`, never on `message`. A refusal without a closed reason (a role the configuration does not grant) carries no `details`. (decision: NOT_STEP_AUTHORITY, MEMBER_OF_CONTRACTOR)

404.description: Not found — also returned for a contract of which the caller’s organization is neither the employer nor the winning contractor (nor, for one statement and its decisions, an organization a step of that statement’s approval chains names), so its existence is never disclosed.

409.description: On sign (of the contract or of an amendment): another person for a side that has already signed (SIDE_ALREADY_SIGNED); on submitting a statement, an approval policy of either chain put in force or retired at the same moment (CONFLICT — retry); on deciding a statement, a step already decided — by another person or at the same moment (STEP_DECIDED); on any command, `expectedVersion` that is not the current version (OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_FAILED — reload and retry), an Idempotency-Key reused with a different request or user (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED) or still in flight (CONFLICT, with Retry-After). When refused for a closed reason, `details` names it: one entry, `path` the area (signature, cancellation, policy, amendment, milestone, statement, decision) and `code` the reason, one of those listed here. Branch on `code` and `details[].code`, never on `message`. A refusal without a closed reason (a role the configuration does not grant) carries no `details`. (decision: STEP_DECIDED)

Retry-After.description: Sent only when this Idempotency-Key is still being processed (CONFLICT): the seconds to wait before retrying with the same key. Absent on every other 409.

422.description: Well-formed but refused by the lifecycle or by configuration (BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION): a contract that is not a draft (CONTRACT_NOT_DRAFT; a SIGNED contract is ended by no route); no `contract.signature` policy in force for the employer, so nobody may sign for it yet (SIGNATURE_POLICY_REQUIRED); two signers whose identities cannot be told apart (ACTOR_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN, fail closed); a cancellation reason outside the configured list (CANCEL_REASON_NOT_ALLOWED) or of a draft a party has signed (SIGNATURE_RECORDED). When refused for a closed reason, `details` names it: one entry, `path` the area (signature, cancellation, policy, amendment, milestone, statement, decision) and `code` the reason, one of those listed here. Branch on `code` and `details[].code`, never on `message`. A refusal without a closed reason (a role the configuration does not grant) carries no `details`. info.title: Rasta — Contract Service
info.description: The contract boundary (CON-003, ADR-068). The draft contract that a tender award creates: the system makes it when construction-service publishes TENDER_AWARDED, after reading the award — and its amount, which is on no event — from construction-service itself (ADR-061 § 4); no user creates one. A contract is read, signed and (while a draft) cancelled by its two parties only: the employer’s organization and the winning contractor’s; anyone else gets 404. Each party signs separately — a recorded acceptance, not a legal signature (Q-95) — and the contract is SIGNED only when both have; the employer may cancel a draft for a closed reason. Who may sign for the employer is the `contract.signature` approval policy of its own organization (/v1/contract-approval-policies): written by a union or the platform, put in force by a platform administrator who is not its author, and never an environment setting; with none in force nobody signs for the employer (422). Amounts are decimal strings of minor units (rials). A SIGNED contract is amended by its employer (a positive change to the price, with a closed reason code and a text), and the amendment takes effect only when both parties have signed it the way they signed the contract; the employer also plans milestones (a title, a planned day and an optional share in basis points) that both parties read. The contractor drafts statements of a signed contract — lines, each optionally against a milestone, the deductions the employer has configured, and the gross, deductions and net computed once by the service — and submits them, which snapshots the separate technical and financial approval chains from the employer’s `contract.statement.technical` and `contract.statement.financial` policies. Each step is then decided by the organization and role it names — technical first, then financial; a person decides a statement at most once and never the one who submitted it — and the last financial approval makes the statement APPROVED, within the contract’s price and its amendments. The settlement boundary with economic-service follows (ADR-068 § 9); no money is ever held or moved here.
